blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block26107698, blockHash0x1873f19af6d4b1423d634e2067220be47f24b4aed3efab69b062aac2a5b0a9fd, facetAddress(updateStopCodes(address,(bool,bool,bool,bool))) on the exact JLTXX token0x09864f52b035ae22ee739dfa5c748fa080d07bd8 returned0x996440281f77b4d664878b0b14a10e909fc3310b. Its verified StopCodesFacet requires ACCOUNT_ADMIN to update per-account stopSubscriptionTo, stopTransferFrom, stopTransferTo and stopRedemptionFrom flags; live token therefore exposes explicit holder transfer/redemption restrictions. This finding covers only the authored Ethereum deployment, not an unbound Solana mint.

branchApplicability.rationale: Exact CUSIP 46655R119 class 4397 publishes transaction NAV for fund subscriptions/redemptions. The holder instrument is a government money-market fund share, not a borrower/CDP liquidation system; external lending integrations do not create fund-level borrower pricing branches.

oracleRisk.summary: JLTXX transaction NAV is calculated and published by the fund for exact CUSIP46655R119, share class4397. Pharos reads that class publisher, not an independent market oracle or guaranteed $1 peg; the issuer can correct NAV and the publisher is a single off-chain availability dependency.
